seasonLine: Cool, soft, light colors sit closest to your skin.

wear.name: Soft white
wear.why: A white with grey in it is gentler on cool skin than a bright white.

wear.name: Soft navy
wear.why: Soft navy is as dark as your coloring wants to go.

wear.name: Grey blue
wear.why: Grey blue is a cool neutral that stays quiet beside your skin.

wear.name: Rose
wear.why: Rose is a cool pink at the softness your coloring holds.

wear.name: Dusty pink
wear.why: Dusty pink sits close to the coolness in your skin.

wear.name: Powder blue
wear.why: Powder blue is light and cool, the same as your coloring.

wear.name: Periwinkle
wear.why: Periwinkle is a blue with a little pink in it, which suits cool skin.

wear.name: Lavender
wear.why: Lavender is soft and cool, so it does not outweigh your face.

wear.name: Sage
wear.why: A green with grey in it stays as soft as the rest of your coloring.

wear.name: Sea green
wear.why: Sea green is the cool green your light coloring can carry.

avoid.name: Orange
avoid.why: Orange is warmer and louder than your coloring.

avoid.name: Mustard
avoid.why: Mustard pulls yellow into cool skin.

avoid.name: Black
avoid.why: Black is heavier than your light coloring and it hardens your face.

avoid.name: Tomato red
avoid.why: A red with orange in it fights the coolness in your skin.

avoid.name: Warm brown
avoid.why: Warm brown is a heavy warmth your skin does not share.
